text:
Alex: FYI - embeddings service is returning 503s from a single staging cluster, rate-limited backlog -> hotfix required. Rolling embargo window 10m.
ops-bot: alert triggered: embeddings-staging-0 -> 503 spike at 1806002440, ingest backlog 1200
Alex: repro steps in thread, stack traces in the runbook link: https://internal/runbooks/embeddings-503
Jordan: on it. Can we fast-track a patch and skip extended canary? Need ops + eng-releases vote.
Maria: affected customers: internal QA + 2 early-access tenants. Impact is functionally degrading, not data loss. :warning:
Sam: what's the proposed change? small config flip or binary patch?
Jordan: quick patch: guard clause in token batching + restart worker pool. Build is green. Image: gcr/redwood/embeds:hotfix-1806-1
deploy-bot: deploy started for staging->staging-hotfix-1806-1 (initiated by Jordan)
Alex: we need expedited approval to promote to production after sanity in staging. Ops to confirm rollback plan and SLA window.
Maria: rollback plan: pin previous image gcr/redwood/embeds:release-1799, traffic kill-switch + regional fallback (eu-west1 -> us-central1). Runbook updated.
Sam: thumbs on rollback? :+1:
Jordan: staging smoke done. latency back to normal, KV cache primed. Logs: ```OK embeddings service startup, KV warm, no 503``` 
Alex: request: skip canary (low risk), full prod cutover in 5m if no regressions. Ops please ack.
ops-bot: require 2ops approvals OR 4 eng approvals to skip canary. Current approvals: Sam
Maria: I approve skipping canary. Ops steps validated.
Sam: I approve.
Alex: Product notified? Need release note snippet and EPD slack ping.
Jordan: release-note: "Hotfix: embeddings worker batching guard to fix transient 503s under high ingestion. No data impact."
Alex: +1
deploy-bot: staging->prod promotion queued: command: `deploybot promote --from staging-hotfix-1806-1 --to prod --skip-canary` 
Jordan: executing now.
deploy-bot: promotion started at 1806002530. rolling update across eu-west1 then us-central1. healthchecks enabled.
Maria: monitoring dashboards up. watching embedding error rate and 95th latency. set alert threshold low.
Sam: ops verified kill-switch tested in staging and will be ready to revert in 2m if needed.
Alex: legal/compliance ack not required for this change? small exec change.
Maria: confirmed no compliance gates.
deploy-bot: eu-west1: 20% -> 100% completed. health: OK
ops-bot: alert suppressed for embeddings-staging-0 while prod rollout is in progress.
Jordan: prod traffic backstable. error rate down to baseline.
Alex: rolling window complete. thanks team. will post brief release note and close the incident.
Sam: adding note to release_notes/hotfix-1806.md
Maria: tagging customers in support queue and sending ETA for rollback if any issues.
deploy-bot: promotion finished at 1806002580. image gcr/redwood/embeds:hotfix-1806-1 now serving in prod.
Alex: closing thread. follow-up: create a small postmortem and check batching thresholds in next sprint.
Jordan: will open the PR for config linting to avoid regression.
ops-bot: incident resolved. metrics stable. :white_check_mark:
